'''Rusty Zion''' of New Smyrna Beach, Florida, was one of the twelve finalists at the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]]. He won the [[1997 Dagobah Regionals (Orlando)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"Age, 22."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/zion.html Rusty Zion], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428142534/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/zion.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I'm a writer for Extreme magazine."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I perform magic and illusions in my spare time."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I also play baseball, and attend Stetson University in Deland, Florida, where I'm a Senior majoring in Marketing/Advertising with a minor in Information Systems."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I have 3 cats and 10 fish."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I enjoy all sports, but just one CCG, and that's Star Wars."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'd like to mention Adam Schoettler and J.T."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Shelton, my friends and Star Wars CCG buddies, both of whom are good enough to have qualified for the World Finals."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"Good luck to everyone in Norfolk."<ref name="dec97bio" />
